question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this read-only grouped-Claw update planner as a core experimental lifecycle contract and land it with its prerequisite ownership/diagnostics stack?
rationale: The patch is more than a bounded bug fix: it creates a public experimental CLI and plan schema over persisted lifecycle state, with a follow-on mutating executor depending on its semantics.

options.title: Sponsor the staged experiment
options.body: Approve the core experimental direction once exact-head redacted lifecycle proof is posted and the prerequisite stack is ready to land in order.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design review
options.body: Keep the PR open while owners decide whether grouped Claw provenance and update planning belong in the core lifecycle contract before accepting the new CLI schema.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the core experimental direction once exact-head redacted lifecycle proof is posted and the prerequisite stack is ready to land in order.
